title: 5fedu Source Lock
description: Reproducible pinned reference to a 5fedu template repository revision. A source-lock is a small contract that records the exact repository identity, commit SHA, template path, and integrity metadata so that a task can reference an exact template revision without loading the entire template into model context or copying it permanently into the public harness.

sourceLock.description: The source-lock contract that pins a single template revision.

repository.description: Git repository URL containing the canonical template. Example: https://github.com/admin5fedu/5f-template-ket-noi-supabase

commitSha.description: Exact full 40-character hex commit SHA. No abbreviated SHAs are permitted because they are not reproducible.

templatePath.description: Relative path within the repository to the template root. Use '.' when the entire repo is the template.

integrity.description: Expected integrity metadata of the template tree at the pinned commit. Used to verify that the materialized copy matches the author's intent and has not been tampered with or corrupted.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used to compute the integrity digest.

hash.description: Hex-encoded hash of the template tree. Computed by hashing the sorted list of relative file paths and their blob SHAs at the pinned commit.

profileCompatibility.description: List of profile names that are compatible with this source lock. When empty or absent, the lock is compatible with all profiles.

moduleIndex.description: Optional index of available modules within the template. Each key is a module identifier. The value contains the name, relative path, list of direct dependencies, and the surfaces it provides. This index is used to extract only the modules needed for a given task rather than materialising the entire template.

path.description: Relative path within the template to this module's root directory

dependencies.description: List of module identifiers that this module directly depends on

surfaces.description: List of surface names (from pattern-inventory.yaml) that this module implements

type.description: Classification: 'module' is a feature module, 'shared' is a shared component library, 'utility' is a utility/helper library

lastVerified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful verification of this source lock against the actual repository.

verificationState.description: Current verification state: 'verified' means the lock matches the materialized copy, 'stale' means the materialized copy differs from the lock, 'unverified' means verification has not been performed.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes explaining why this lock exists, when it was created, and any relevant context for the agent or maintainer.
